growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.name: Agronegocio Decision Maker
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.demographics: Owners and managers of agribusiness operations that need clearer lead flow, follow-up, and conversion tracking.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.painPoints: Disorganized lead intake, slow response times, manual WhatsApp follow-up, and weak attribution between campaigns and sales.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.goals: Capture qualified leads faster, route them to the right segment page, and keep every follow-up measurable.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.toneOfVoice: Direct, practical, operational, and focused on profit and speed.

growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.name: Agency Growth Lead
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.demographics: Owners and operators of lead generation agencies that need repeatable delivery and visible pipeline health.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.painPoints: Campaign chaos, duplicated contacts, inconsistent messaging, and no clear separation between clients or squads.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.goals: Standardize outreach, keep tenants isolated, and present clear next steps for every prospect.

growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.name: Enterprise Revenue Operations
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.demographics: Enterprise teams that require governance, segmentation, and predictable reporting across channels.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.painPoints: Fragmented workflows, manual data hygiene, and poor visibility into campaign performance.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.goals: Create controlled landing pages, segment-specific journeys, and auditable activity histories.

growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.name: SMB Business Owner
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.demographics: Small and mid-sized business owners that need a clear, low-friction CRM entry point.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.painPoints: Too many tools, little consistency, and no clean handoff from lead to opportunity.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.goals: Get a simple path from form submission to follow-up with measurable outcomes.

growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.name: Franchise Expansion Lead
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.demographics: Franchise owners and expansion managers who need consistent messaging and distributed lead handling.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.painPoints: Hard to keep brand consistency across units, difficult to track inquiries, and slow qualification.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.goals: Unify the funnel, split by region or segment, and keep every inquiry traceable.

growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.name: Solutions Buyer
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.demographics: Decision makers searching for specific solutions and wanting a direct next step.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.painPoints: Generic pitches, unclear value propositions, and landing pages that do not match intent.
growerp.marketing.MarketingPersona.goals: Match content to intent, route leads by segment, and present a short conversion path.
